terbaru.judul: Fermionic quantum cellular automata in 2d are trivial
terbaru.pelajaran: Fermionic quantum cellular automata (QCA) are automorphisms of local fermionic operator algebras ($\mathbb Z_2$-graded superalgebras) that have bounded spread: they map local operators to nearby operators.

terbaru.judul: Braids on the Stranded Cellular Automata Model
terbaru.pelajaran: The Stranded Cellular Automata (SCA) model is a grid of cells such that each cell can contain 0, 1, or 2 strands, together with two cellular automata that control when and how strands turn and cross.
In this work, we introduce the concept of programmable cellular automata, where we represent the system as Python code.

terbaru.judul: Bridging simulation length scales with cellular automata
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work, we present a cellular automata (CA) approach for generating arbitrarily large lattice starting configurations.

terbaru.judul: Non-abelian quantum cellular automata: $1{+}1$-dimensional $SU(2)$ Yang--Mills with fermions
terbaru.pelajaran: This work provides a digital quantum simulation scheme for $1{+}1$-dimensional $SU(2)$ Yang--Mills theory with Dirac fermions.

terbaru.judul: The Prime Clockwork: A Dynamic Representation of Modular and Multiplicative Arithmetic
terbaru.pelajaran: The way numbers are represented strongly influences which arithmetic structures are easy to see.

terbaru.judul: Collision-based logic in Lenia and its composition boundary
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper constructs an INHIBIT gate from collisions of the Orbium glider.

terbaru.judul: Optical free space extreme learning machine for the implementation of emergent complex systems
terbaru.pelajaran: Here, we introduce an optical extreme learning machine for the simulation of a wide range of cellular automata.

terbaru.judul: Learning PDE Time-Stepping with Neural Cellular Automata
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we propose a trainable Neural Cellular Automata (NCA) based surrogate model for learning long time PDE dynamics.

terbaru.judul: The istr-graph: Interactive Visualisation of any Classic-Graph in DDLab
terbaru.pelajaran: Any type of attractor basin (classic-graph) created in DDLab can now be visualised, manipulated, and deconstructed as a drag/drop ``interactive state transition graph'' (istr-graph).
